newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore shares flat at midday, block deals seen.
newsitem.headline: Singapore shares flat at midday, block deals seen.

text.p: The Singapore share market was fairly flat at mid-morning on Tuesday with mostly blocked deals dominating blue-chip trading, dealers said.
"What we are seeing is the tail-end of the portfolio liquidation which began since October. At these valuations, it is common to see block deals dominate," a dealer said.

At mid-morning, blue-chips Fraser & Neave saw 261,000 shares of 264,000 shares traded blocked at S$14.20 (US$10.07), Singapore Press Holding saw 1.345 million of its 1.38 million shares blocked at S$23.23-23.27 and Straits Steamship Land saw 660,000 shares of its 661,000 shares blocked at S$4.18.
The Straits Times Industrials Index was 2.62 points off at 2,073.16. Turnover was 23.4 million shares, with gainers leading losers by 94 to 35.
Dealers said speculation dominated the rest of the market activity in shares like United Pulp Paper and L&M, which were among the actives with 2.7 million and 500,000 shares.
Creative Technology saw some correction to Monday's gains, leading losers after shedding $0.55 to S$9.25 on 36,000 shares.
NatSteel and CityDev were among gainers, rising $0.12 and S$0.10 to S$2.66 and S$10.80 respectively.
